mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AEO for a pool business?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing AEO results can vary, but typically, you might begin to see initial improvements within 3 to 6 months. This depends on factors such as the competitiveness of your local market, the current authority of your website, and the consistency of your optimization efforts. AEO is a continuous process; sustained effort in creating and optimizing high-quality, answer-focused content will yield long-term benefits in search visibility and lead generation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial AEO results for pool businesses can be seen within 3 to 6 months, depending on market competition and ongoing optimization efforts.
